scope: 25 accepted records only in words-003.json and words-004.json; two rejected records excluded.
method: Read every accepted question, answer, explanation and choices. Re-read all25 linked dictionary etymologies via web, and additional Word Origin/Did You Know passages where needed; also checked gage for mortgage. Compared full q+a+d against published, staged including rejected, and sibling raw candidates, excluding current card copies; read nearest neighbors and targeted word/stem matches. Direct HTTP attempts were403 but browser-indexed dictionary content was successfully read.

recommendations.issue: The explanation can imply that guide was a later English use. The source says constellation, Polaris and guide were all used on English adoption in the16th century; center of attention appears in17th.
recommendations.suggestedExplanation: In English, the word named the constellation, Polaris and a guide. Its figurative use for a focus of attention followed.

recommendations.issue: Freezing flesh is an implausible activity for the relevant stone/coffin context.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Replace Freezing it with Drying it.

recommendations.issue: Orchid and avocado independently yielding testicle are factual distinct histories but reuse the same surprise.
recommendations.suggestedChange: Retain if distinct etymologies meet the editorial policy; otherwise hold this one for a later batch. This is not a definite duplicate.
